Hi Alex / Jordan,

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciated the context on your planned rollout and latency/cost targets. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Goal: 4-week pilot for the internal search use case (up to 100k tokens/day, realtime latency SLOs).
- Success criteria: <10% API tail latency > 500ms and <5% degradation in relevance vs current baseline.
- Redwood deliverables: hosted pilot environment, onboarding runbook, 1 scoping call with your infra team, and a simple eval harness to track quality.

Attached is a short SOW and our standard pilot terms. Action items:
1) If procurement/legal has a standard PO/terms we should use, please share the contact or attach the template.
2) If pilot timing works, we can target week of Mar 9 to start (flexible).
3) If you'd like, we can set a 15-min intro between our legal and your counsel to speed review.

I attached: SOW_ACME_v1.pdf (pilot scope & pricing).

Would you be able to confirm the procurement contact and whether the proposed start week works?

Thanks — happy to jump on another quick call if useful.

Best,
